query: UPDATE schedule_repos sr SET catch_up_pending_for = NULL, catch_up_last_probe_at = NULL, catch_up_run_id = NULL, catch_up_run_for = NULL WHERE sr.repo_id IN (SELECT r.id FROM repos r JOIN repo_hosts h ON h.id = r.repo_host_id WHERE h.machine_id = $1) AND (sr.catch_up_pending_for IS NOT NULL OR sr.catch_up_run_id IS NOT NULL) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM schedule_machine_wake w WHERE w.schedule_id = sr.schedule_id AND w.machine_id = $1 AND w.mode = 'wait')
